message.text: A minion is checking this now. It will read this card's saved messages to see whether the pieces and the joined text were both sent, then fix it so your words go out once. I'll report back here.

The cause is found. The card's agent panel was drawing your joined message a second time as a "you" line, even though your words were already on the card. A minion is adding a one-line guard so a message relayed from a card isn't drawn again. Messages you type straight to an agent will still show. I'll confirm here once it's live.

Fixed. Your joined message was only saved once, and the card panel was drawing a second copy of it. The panel now skips messages relayed from a card. Anything you type straight to an agent still shows. Reload the page to pick it up.
